summary:
Israelis voted on Tuesday in the first general election since the Hamas attack of October 7, 2023, with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu facing Gadi Eisenkot, the leading opposition contender. Most polling shows Netanyahu's coalition losing its majority, but exit polls after voting closes late on Tuesday may not give a final result for days.

Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won a fourth, non-consecutive term as Brazil's president, defeating far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro with 51.79% of the vote. Trump said the result 'looked like another rigged election', while Bolsonaro's party acknowledged it and Bolsonaro was reported to have refused to concede.

Officials say Netanyahu pushed for an attack on Iran before the Israeli election and that Israel's military chief resisted him. On the eve of the vote, Netanyahu suggested he and Trump could restart the war against Iran if he wins, after Trump said they should 'finish the job'.

headlines.title: Israelis vote in first election since October 7 attack
headlines.summary: Israelis voted on Tuesday in the first general election since the Hamas attack of October 7, 2023. Exit polls are expected soon after voting closes late on Tuesday, but a final verdict might take days.

headlines.title: Netanyahu reportedly pressed military to act against Iran before vote
headlines.summary: Officials say Netanyahu pushed for an attack on Iran before the election and that Israel's military chief resisted him. Netanyahu then pressed in recent days for a separate action short of an overt strike, according to an official and a person briefed on the matter.

headlines.title: Lula wins fourth term, defeating Flávio Bolsonaro
headlines.summary: Lula won a fourth, non-consecutive term as Brazil's president, defeating far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro with 51.79% of the vote. Trump said the result 'looked like another rigged election', while Bolsonaro's party acknowledged it.

headlines.title: Mecca pact states hold talks in Iran to prevent renewed war
headlines.summary: Senior officials from Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan held talks in Iran on Monday aimed at preventing renewed Middle East fighting. Saudi Defence Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman attended the talks, which Tehran described as 'very good'.

headlines.title: Ceasefire in Russian-occupied Oleshky begins for aid mission
headlines.summary: A localized ceasefire brokered by US first lady Melania Trump took effect at 3am on Tuesday to allow an aid mission into Oleshky, where around 2,000 people remain stranded. Zelenskyy said 280 drones and 16 ballistic missiles were launched overnight despite the truce.

headlines.title: Drone strikes in Sudan kill 21 and cut eastern power
headlines.summary: A drone strike on a Nyala market in Darfur killed 21 people and wounded at least 40, a medical source told AFP. A coordinated Rapid Support Forces drone attack on five power stations caused mass outages in eastern Sudan, a government official said.

headlines.title: Jordan strikes alleged militant hideouts in southern Syria
headlines.summary: Jordan's air force struck what it called militant hideouts in southern Syria, saying suspects in last week's church attack in Jordan were linked to them. Syrian health officials said the strike on a village killed five people, and Syria gave a different account of events.

headlines.title: Attacks in Ethiopia's Oromia region leave dozens dead
headlines.summary: At least 48 people were killed and more than 31 wounded in attacks by armed men in Oromia's Shirka district, Addis Standard reported. A separate report says 60 Christians were killed, and church officials say 20 homes burned down.
